pr_title: fix: accept post data params for request.get and request.head
pr_body: #17008 allowed us to send post data via GET, however context.request.get still didn't have the `data` param definition. This PR add the param for GET and HEAD. issue_context.title: [Missing functionality] no option to send GET request with Body
comments: Would `request.fetch('...', { method: 'GET', data: })` work for you?
Ouch, we are indeed not accepting raw body into any of the fetch requests.

will this functionality be added soon? we will appreciate it if this could be delivered so we could add it to our testing cycle that involved many Get requests with Payload/ body.
any timeline for this? 
Thanks again

@yury-s @pavelfeldman 
i have tested it with latest version playwright 1.26.
It seems to work with fetch with GET method: fetch('http://test.test.com', { method: 'GET'....  ( which is great) BUT it does not work with request.get ( as it mentioned in my first comment) . 
should it work also with request.get ??
thanks in advance

@yury-s @pavelfeldman I found that the context.request.get API definition doesn't have `data` param, and I fixed the issue.
Could you review it? Thank you in advance.
@YusukeIwaki @yury-s was it fixed and deployed? if not when it be available?
@moshikd It seems Playwright 1.27 includes the fix.

review_comments: Yeah, it's unfortunate that our lint doesn't catch errors like this when `context.request[method]` syntax is used.
